description: Explore blockchain and crypto market data with Nansen. Look up tokens and wallet labels, compare token prices and market activity, inspect Smart Money holdings and flows, and analyze public wallet portfolios, counterparties, related addresses, and profit and loss. Supported tools also provide Hyperliquid perpetual market and position data. Connect your Nansen account to access the data. Tool calls consume Nansen API credits from your connected account. Availability depends on supported chains, markets, and account access. This plugin provides analytics and cannot place trades or transfer assets.
